newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey's Kocbank plans $75 million syndicated loan.
newsitem.headline: Turkey's Kocbank plans $75 million syndicated loan.

text.p: Turkey's private Kocbank has mandated Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi, Nationsbank, Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank and Credit Lyonnais to arrange a $75 million one-year loan, Kocbank assistant general manager Suphi Bilgin said.
Bilgin said the pre-export financing facility would have a spread of 52.5 basis points over LIBOR and an all-in cost of 80 basis points over LIBOR.
"The loan is expected to be signed in late April," Bilgin told Reuters.
